question: Should OpenClaw accept a node-to-model tool advertisement contract, and should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90431 be the canonical implementation path after conflict and compatibility repair?
rationale: The feature is not a narrow bug fix: it changes which connected-node capabilities become model-visible executable tools, so repository policy requires maintainer product/security acceptance before implementation or closure.

options.title: Use the open PR as the candidate path
options.body: Resolve the conflicts and remaining compatibility/security questions in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90431, then land it as the canonical implementation if the trust model is accepted.

options.title: Keep wrapper plugins for now
options.body: Reject direct node-advertised tools for now and keep plugin/MCP wrappers as the supported extension path until a safer contract is designed.

options.title: Narrow to an SDK helper first
options.body: Defer node-advertised tools and instead add a smaller plugin SDK/Gateway invocation helper to remove the HTTP token loopback workaround.

recommendation.title: Use the open PR as the candidate path
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflicts and remaining compatibility/security questions in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90431, then land it as the canonical implementation if the trust model is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the current open candidate PR and shows the clearest recent history on the node/Gateway/tool boundary.
